evaluation_scope: One approved synthetic customer-audio UltraVox hosted API turn test. The test creates a server-WebSocket call, streams locally generated synthetic customer speech as s16le PCM, listens for transcript and agent audio, closes the socket, and deletes the call.

approved_live_test.approval_scope: one synthetic customer-audio UltraVox live test

provider.voice_selection_rule: Optional. If the env var is blank, omit voice and let UltraVox use its default voice. If set, the value must be a public included voice ID or unique voice name.

synthetic_case.customer_text: Can you quickly explain what this offer is about?
synthetic_case.fallback_input_audio_note: Use only if local Windows speech synthesis is unavailable. The fixture is synthetic provider-generated audio from ULTRAVOX-002, not real customer audio, not private speech, and not a new TTS provider call.
synthetic_case.system_prompt: You are running one synthetic provider latency test for a local guarded sales-agent project. The user audio is synthetic. Answer in one short sentence only. Say that this is a quick synthetic test and no customer data is being used. Do not sell, do not collect personal data, do not ask follow-up questions.
success_criteria: create call succeeds with env-only API key
joinUrl is received but not logged
synthetic customer WAV is generated locally or copied from the prior synthetic ULTRAVOX-002 fixture if local speech synthesis is unavailable
synthetic customer PCM is sent to UltraVox
a transcript event or agent audio is received
first agent audio timing is recorded when available
call delete succeeds or is retried after call settlement
no real customer audio is uploaded
